answer: A bond is refunded only after 22 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jade counter is kept in cipher and terrace reveals each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 22 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3970 identities would post 4773 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
